brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: A tool rack that hangs on a wall
requirements.evidence: 6 cells (piece 0,0 / 1,-1 / 1,-2 on levels 0 and 1). Cells 0,0 and 1,-2 present wall faces that lie in one plane (slot 3) for hanging; cells 1,-1 stand forward. Caps and joint bolts are fitted. Nothing here can check how much load the wall mount takes.
2 two-storey keyhole hangers (hex-acc-keyhole-x2), on the shared wall face of cells 0,0 and 1,-2 (accessory:0#0,0#3 and accessory:0#1,-2#3).
6 hook plates (hex-acc-hook), 2 hooks each, so 12 hooks. One plate per cell on the front-facing slot 0, on both storeys.

requirements.requirement: Small hand tools shown hanging on the hooks
requirements.evidence: 3 props hang on the upper hooks: 2 cable coils and 1 roll of gaffer tape. The configurator only lets a cable coil, gaffer tape or goggles hang on a hook, so screwdrivers and pliers could not be shown. The lower hooks were refused because in the preview the rack stands on the bench and anything on them would hang through it.

finish.summary: I built a wall-hung tool rack from 6 hex cells, 2 storeys high. Two of the three columns sit against the wall and the third sits forward between them. That's needed because a straight row of hex cells has a zigzag back, so no two of its faces lie flat on the wall together. The two wall-side columns each have a two-storey keyhole hanger on the wall face. All three columns have a hook plate on their front-facing side on both storeys: 6 plates with 2 hooks each, so 12 hooks. Open faces are capped and the joints are bolted. That brings the parts list to 41, just over the usual 40-part guideline. The collision check came back clear with no rule errors. The only note left lists 8 more faces that could take a cap, which is informational. For staging, the configurator only lets a cable coil, a roll of gaffer tape or FPV goggles hang on a hook, so I couldn't show actual hand tools on them. One cable coil, one roll of gaffer tape and a second cable coil hang on 3 hooks, all on the upper storey. Lower hooks were refused because in the preview the rack stands on the bench, and anything on them would hang through it.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
